title: The Day Winter Came to Three Quarter Town
description:
The first snow comes softly to Three-Quarter Town.

Before dawn, the hills turn white. Then the rooftops, the church spire, the old fences, the bakery windows, and every quiet doorstep begin to change. One by one, the town wakes to winter.

Some light the fire. Some pull old scarves from wooden chests. Some press their hands to frosted glass. Some step outside and leave the first footprints in the snow.

Nothing grand happens. The whole world simply remembers to breathe slowly.

A gentle winter story about the first snow, old rituals, warm windows, and a town entering the quiet season together.

— Three-Quarter Town

#ThreeQuarterTown #TheFirstSnow #WinterStory #SnowyVillage #DreamyAnimation
